name: number
title: Number
description: A number that rolls to its new value: every digit is its own column on a spring, the columns start one after another from the right, and a new leading digit opens in width. Separators follow the locale; screen readers get the final value at once.
author: ARLing s. r. o. (https://arling.sk)
docs:
Number from ARLing Motion (MIT).
React: import { NumberTicker } from "@/components/ui/motion-number".
The logic is in lib/arling-motion-number.js (typed by the .d.ts next to it) and works without React: createNumber on your own markup.
Styles were added to your global CSS under @layer components (Tailwind v4).
With Tailwind v3 or no Tailwind, add https://arling.sk/motion/components/number/number.css to your styles instead.
Live demo and docs: https://arling.sk/motion/#number
